items.name: Survey Vessel
items.desc: The recovered Sentinel-class hull — scarred, patched, half-understood. Yours from the start.

items.name: Vanguard
items.desc: A pre-collapse picket ship. Lean, fast lines. Identical guns to every other hull.

items.name: Interceptor
items.desc: Escort-pattern fighter recovered from a dead carrier's rack.

items.name: Shipbreaker
items.desc: An improvised hull welded together from salvage. Ugly. Effective. Cosmetic only.

items.name: Warden
items.desc: Heavy archival-defense frame. Broad shoulders, same loadout.

items.name: Dreadnought
items.desc: A pre-collapse capital hull, scaled to a pilot who no longer exists.

items.name: Archive Ship
items.desc: An intact librarian vessel. It still runs its cataloguing routines between your volleys.

items.name: Terra
items.desc: The seed-vault world as it was — blue marble, live cloud deck, night side lit.

items.name: Mars
items.desc: The fourth planet. Iron-oxide dust, the tallest volcano in the system, and two captured moons that never quite settled.

items.name: Europa
items.desc: Jupiter's ice moon. A shell of fractured water ice over a salt ocean deeper than every sea on Earth combined.

items.name: Titan
items.desc: Saturn's largest moon, and the only other world with rivers. They run methane, under an orange nitrogen haze.

items.name: Triton
items.desc: Neptune's big moon, orbiting backwards — a captured world. Nitrogen geysers still vent through its pink cantaloupe crust.

items.name: Pluto
items.desc: Out past Neptune, where the sun is just a bright star. A nitrogen-ice heart sits on a crust of frozen rock.

items.name: Ember
items.desc: Standard-issue warm ordnance flash — orange muzzle, orange bloom.

items.name: Ion Blue
items.desc: Cold blue volley trails and impacts.

items.name: Void Violet
items.desc: Deep violet with a hard white core.

items.name: Monochrome
items.desc: Clean white. For players who want to read the board over the spectacle.
